frame.note: The region reported, not a located site.

attribution.name: NASA Worldview Snapshots
attribution.note: Public domain, courtesy of NASA EOSDIS GIBS.

before.shows: What the eye would see from orbit. Cloud is white, forest dark green, silt-laden floodwater pale brown.

after.shows: Bands 7-2-1. Cloud and snow read cyan, vegetation green, bare rock and debris brown, open water near-black — so a new channel or a landslide scar shows through haze that hides it in true colour.

comparable_note: The two frames come from different instruments — true colour before, shortwave infrared after — because nothing else could see the ground on both dates. They are shown side by side rather than as a slider: sliding between two instruments shows the instrument changing.
